cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Strategic Retreat
cards.instruction: Describe every loss of control as a deliberate concession made from strength.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've graciously handed you the chess club chairmanship. You'll have room to develop under this arrangement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You lost the vote. I need the cupboard key for tonight's match.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'm releasing equipment control. Choose a time for the handover; I'll fit around your first match.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: And remove yourself as administrator. I can't change the fixtures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A full release, then. I want you making decisions without my safety net. Tell me which access you need first and I'll remove mine in that order. Strong leadership knows when to make room.

reason: Make actual vote defeat and access demands cause claimed generous concessions, while A yields handover timing and removal order to sustain B cooperation.
